G4002.def:
πέντε
indecl., οἱ, αἱ, τά,
five: Mt 14:17, al
(AS)

G4004.def:
πεντήκοντα
indecl., οἱ, αἱ, τά,
fifty: Lc 7:41 16:6, Jo 8:57 21:11, At 13:20; ἀνὰ π., Lc 9:14; κατὰ π., Mc 6:40.†
(AS)

G4005.def:
πεντηκοστός, -ή, -όν
[in LXX for חֲמִישִׁי, חֲמִישִׁי, Lv 25:10-11, 4Ki.15:23 15:27; 1Ma.4:1-61, 2Ma.14:4; ἡ π., Tob.2:1, 2Ma.12:32 * ;]
fiftieth. As subst., ἡ π.;
__(a) (sc. μερίς), at Athens, a tax of two per cent.;
__(b) (sc. ἡμέρα, i.e. the fiftieth day after the Passover), Pentecost, the second of the three great Jewish feasts (To, 2Mac, ll. with; ἑορτὴ ἑβδομάδων, Dt 16:10, al.) : At 2:1 20:16, 1Co 16:8.†
(AS)

G4006.def:
πεποίθησις, -εως, ἡ
(πείθω), [in LXX: 4Ki.18:19 (בִּטָּחוֹן)* ;]
confidence: 2Co 1:15 3:4 10:2, Ef 3:12; before εἰς, 2Co 8:22; ἐν, Fp 3:4 (the word is condemned by the Atticists, see Rutherford, NPhr., 355).†
(AS)

G4008.def:
πέραν
adv., [in LXX for עֵבֶר and cognate forms ;]
on the other side, across (usually with the idea of water lying between);
__(a) as in the older poets, as prep. with genitive: τ. θαλάσσης, Jo 6:1, 17 6:22, 25; τ. Ἰορδάνου, Mt 4:15 (LXX), Mt 4:25 19:1, Mc 3:8 10:1, Jo 1:28 3:26 10:40; τ. χειμάρρου τ. Κέδρων, Jo 18:1;
__(b) τὸ π., the region beyond, the other side: Mt 8:18, 28 14:22 16:5, Mc 4:35 5:21 6:45 8:13; τ. θαλάσσης, Mc 5:1; τ. λίμνης, Lc 8:22.†
(AS)

G4009.def:
πέρας, -ατος, τό
(πέρα, beyond), [in LXX chiefly for קֵץ, קָצָה and cognate forms ;]
an end, limit, boundary;
__(a) of space: chiefly in pl., τὰ π. τ. γῆς, Mt 12:42, Lc 11:31; τ. οἰκουμένης, Rm 10:18 (LXX);
__(b) (opposite to ἀρχή) the end: with genitive, ἀντιλογίας, Hb 6:10.†
(AS)

G4010.def:
Πέργαμος, -ου, ἡ
(so Xen., Paus., al., but -ον, τό in Strabo, Polyb., and most writers, also in Inscr.; in NT the termination is uncertain)
Pergamum, a city of Mysia: Ap 1:11 2:12.†
(AS)

G4011.def:
Πέργη, -ης, ἡ
Perga, a city of Pamphylia: At 13:13-14 14:25.†
(AS)

G4012.def:
περί,
prep. with genitive, accusative (in cl. also with dative; cf. M, Pr., 105f.),
with radical sense round about (as distinct from ἀμφί, on both sides).
__I. C. genitive,
__1. of place, about (poët.).
__2. Causal, about, on account of, concerning, in reference to: Mt 2:8, Mc 1:44, Lc 4:38, Jo 16:26, At 28:21, al. mult.; τὰ περί, with genitive, the things concerning one, one's state or case: Mc 5:27, At 1:3 28:15, Ef 6:22, al.; at the beginning of a sentence, περί, regarding, as to, 1Co 7:1, al.; in the sense on account of (Mt 26:28, 1Co 1:13, al.), often with ὑπέρ as variant (cf. M, Pr., 105).
__II. C. accusative,
__1. of place, about, around: Mt 3:4, Mc 1:6, Lc 13:8, At 22:6, al.; οἱ περί, with accusative of person(s), of one's associates, friends, etc., Mc 4:10, Lc 22:49, Jo 11:19, At 13:13; οἱ περὶ τ. τοιαῦτα ἐργάται, At 19:25; metaphorically, about, as to, concerning: 1Tm 1:19 6:4 2Tm 2:18 3:8, Tt 2:7; τὰ περὶ ἐμέ, Fp 2:23; αἱ περὶ τ. λοιπὰ ἐπιθυμίαι, Mc 4:19.
__2. Of time, in a loose reckoning, about, near: Mt 20:3, 5 6, 9 27:46, Mc 6:48, At 10:3, 9 22:6.
__III. In composition: round about (περιβάλλω, περίκειμαι), beyond, over and above (περιποιέω, περιλείπω), to excess (περιεργάζομαι, περισσεύω).
(AS)

G4013.def:
περι-άγω
[in LXX: Am 2:10 (הָלַךְ hi.); Is 28:27, Eze.47:2 (סָבַב hi., ho.); Eze.37:2 46:21 (עָבַר hi), 2Ma.4:38 2Mac 6:10 * ;]
__1. to lead about or around: with accusative of person(s), 1Co 9:5.
__2. Intrans., to go about: At 13:11; before ἐν, Mt 4:23; with accusative loc. (governed by the περι-, not so in cl., see Bl., § 34, 1; 53, 1), Mt 9:35 23:15, Mc 6:6.†
(AS)

G4014.def:
περι-αιρέω, -ῶ
[in LXX chiefly for סוּר hi. ;]
to take away that which surrounds, take away, take off (τείχη, Hdt., Thuc.; χιτῶνα, Plat.; δακτύλιον, Gn 41:42, cf. σφρηγῖδα, Hdt., ii, 151) : τ. κάλυΜΜα, pass., 2Co 3:16; as nautical term (RV, cast off), ἀγκύρας, At 27:40; absol., to cast loose: At 28:13. Metaphorical, to take away entirely: ἐλπίς, pass., At 27:20; ἁμαρτίας, Hb 10:11.†
(AS)

G4015.def:
περι-αστράπτω
[in LXX: 4Ma.4:10 * ;]
to flash around: with accusative, At 9:3; before περί At 22:6 (Eccl, and Byzant.).†
(AS)

G4016.def:
περι-βάλλω
[in LXX chiefly for כָּסָה pi., also for לָבַשׁ, עָטָה, etc. ;]
to throw around or over, put on or over;
__(a) of siege or defen­sive works: χάρακά σοι, Lc 19:43 (WH, mg.; παρεμβ-, WH, txt.);
__(b) of clothing, to put on, wrap about, clothe with: with accusative of thing(s), Lc 23:11; with accusative of person(s), Mt 25:36, 38 25:43; with dupl. accusative (not cl.; Bl., § 34, 4), Jo 19:2; pf. pass., to have wrapped round one: with accusative of thing(s) (cl.), Mc 14:51 16:5, Ap 7:9, 13 10:1 11:3 12:1 17:4 18:16 19:13; with dative of thing(s), Ap 4:4 (WH, txt.; before ἐν, WH, mg.); fut., before ἐν (of. Dt 22:12, Sl 45:9, 13), Ap 3:5. Mid., to clothe oneself, wrap round or put on oneself: absol., Mt 6:29, Lc 12:27, Ap 3:18; with accusative of thing(s), Mt 6:31, At 12:8, Ap 19:8.†
(AS)

G4017.def:
περι-βλέπω
[in LXX for שׁוּר, etc. ;]
to look around (at). Mid., to look about one (at) : absol., Mc 9:8 10:23; with inf., Mc 5:32; with accusative of person(s), Mc 3:5, 34, Lc 6:10; πάντα, Mc 11:11.†
(AS)

G4018.def:
περι-βόλαιον, -ου, τό
(περιβάλλω), [in LXX chiefly for כְּסוּת, לְבוּשׁ and cognate forms ;]
that which is thrown around, a covering, in NT,
__(a) a mantle (Sl 102:27, Is 59:17, al.) : Hb 1:12" (LXX)
__(b) a veil: 1Co 11:15 (but see ICC, in l).†
(AS)

G4019.def:
περι-δέω
[in LXX: Jó 12:18 (אָסַר)* ;]
to tie round, bind round: with accusative and dative, pass., Jo 11:44.†
(AS)

G4020.def:
περι-εργάζομαι
[in LXX: Wis.8:5 א1, Sir.3:23 * ;]
__1. to waste one's labour about a thing.
__2. to be a busybody: 2Ts 3:11 (cf. Plat., Apol., 19 B).†
(AS)

G4021.def:
περίεργος, -ον
__I. of persons;
__1. over careful.
__2. curious, meddling, a busybody: 1Tm 5:13.
__II. Of things;
__1. over-wrought.
__2. super­fluous.
__3. curious, uncanny; τὰ π., curious arts, magic: At 19:19 (see Deiss., BS, 3235.).†
(AS)

G4022.def:
περι-έρχομαι
[in LXX chiefly for סָבַב ;]
to go about (as an itinerant): At 19:13 28:13 (περιελόντες, WH, R, mg.), Hb 11:37; τ. οἰκίας, from house to house: 1Tm 5:13.†
(AS)

G4023.def:
περι-έχω,
[in LXX for H661, H5362 hi., H6822 pi., etc. ;]
__1. to surround, encompass: Lc 5:9 (cf. MM, xix).
__2. to comprehend, include, contain, esp. of books: with accusative, At 23:25, Rec.; accusative to a late usage, intrans. (BL, § 53, 1.3; MM, xix; Hort, in l), it stands written, 1Pe 2:6.†
(AS)

G4024.def:
περι-ζώννυμι and -ύω
(see Veitch, see word), [in LXX chiefly for חָגַר, also for אָזַר, etc. ;]
to gird (with dupl, accusative, as ὁ περιζωννύων με δύναμιν, Sl 18:32): pass., αἱ ὀσφύες περιεζωσμέναι, Lc 12:35; π. ζώνην χρυσῆν, Ap 1:13 15:6 (but see infr.). Mid., to gird oneself: Lc 12:37 17:8 (and so perh. Re, ll. with supr., cf. 1Rs 2:4); with accusative of thing(s) (figuratively), τ. ὀσφύν, Ef 6:14 (before ἐν, cf. 1Cr 15:27).†
(AS)

G4025.def:
περί-θεσις, -εως, ἡ
(περιτίθημι), [in Sm.: Sl 32:9 * ;]
a putting around, putting on: 1Pe 3:3.†
(AS)

G4026.def:
περι-ίστημι (Rec. ΐστημι)
[in LXX: Js 6:3 (סָבַב), 2Rs 13:31 (נָצַב ni.), 1Rs 4:16, Ep. Jr 37:1-21, Jdth.5:22, 2Ma.14:9 * ;]
__1. to place around.
__2. to stand around: Jo 11:42; with accusative of person(s), At 25:7. Mid. (in late writers), to turn oneself about to avoid, to shun: with accusative of thing(s), 2Tm 2:16, Tt 3:9.†
(AS)

G4027.def:
περι-κάθαρμα, -τος, τό
(περικαθαίρω, to purify on all sides or completely, Dt 18:10, Js 5:4, 4Ma.1:29*), [in LXX: Pv 21:18 (כֹּפֶר)* ;]
__1. a victim, expiation (Pr, l.with).
__2. refuse, rubbish: pl., 1Co 4:13 (see ICC, in l).†
(AS)

G4028.def:
περι-καλύπτω
[in LXX for כָּסָה pi., שָׁבַץ pu., etc. ;]
to cover around, cover up or over. with accusative, Mc 14:65, Lc 22:64; pass., before χρυσίῳ, Hb 9:4.†
(AS)

G4029.def:
περί-κειμαι
[in LXX: Ep. Je 24, 58, 4Ma.12:3 * ;]
__1. to lie round about: μύλος, λίθος (RV, were hanged about), Mc 9:42, Lc 17:2; νεφος μαρτύρων, Hb 12:1.
__2. to have around one, be clothed with: At 28:20; figuratively, ἀσθένειαν, Hb 5:2.†
(AS)

G4030.def:
περι-κεφαλαία, -ας, ἡ
[in LXX for כּוֹבַע, קוֹבַע ;]
a helmet: figuratively, 1Ts 5:8; with genitive explic., π. τ. σωτηρίου, Ef 6:17 (cf. Is 59:17).†
(AS)

G4031.def:
περι-κρατής, -ές
[in LXX: Da TH Sus 1:39 A * ;]
having full command of: At 27:16.†
(AS)

G4032.def:
περι-κρύπτω
to conceal entirely, keep hidden: late 2 aor., περιέκρυβσν (but see BL, § 17; Soph., Lex., see word περικρύβω), Lc 1:24.†
(AS)

G4033.def:
περι-κυκλόω, -ῶ
[in LXX chiefly for סָבַב ;]
to encircle, encompass: of a besieged city, Lc 19:43.†
(AS)

G4034.def:
περι-λάμπω
to shine around: with accusative, Lc 2:9, At 26:13.†
(AS)

G4035.def:
περι-λείπομαι depon. mid, and pass.,
[in LXX: 2Cr 34:21 A (שָׁאַר ni.), 2Ma.1:31 2Mac 8:14, 4Ma.12:6 4Mac 13:18 * ;]
to be left remaining, remain over, survive: 1Ts 4:15 4:17†
(AS)

G4036.def:
περί-λυπος, -ον
[in LXX: Sl 42:5, 11, I Et 8:69, al. ;]
very sad, deeply grieved: Mt 26:38, Mc 6:26 14:34, Lc 18:23.†
(AS)

G4037.def:
περι-μένω
[in LXX: Gn 49:18 (קָוָה pi.), Wis.8:12 * ;]
to wait for: with acce., At 1:4.†
(AS)

G4038.def:
πέριξ
adv., [in Al.: Lv 13:33 * ;]
round about: αἱ π. πολεῖς, At 5:16.†
(AS)

G4039.def:
περι-οικέω, -ῶ
to dwell round about: with accusative, Lc 1:65.†
(AS)

G4040.def:
περί-οικος, -ον
[in LXX for כִּכָּר, etc. ;]
dwelling around; as subst., ὁ π., a neighbour: Lc 1:58 (cf. πλησίον).†
(AS)

G4041.def:
περιούσιος, -ον
(περίειμι, to be over and above), [in LXX: Êx 19:5 23:22, Dt 7:6 14:2 26:18 (סְגֻלָּה, עַם)* ;]
one's own, of one's own possession: λαὸς π. (cf. LXX, ll. with), Tt 2:14.†
(AS)

G4042.def:
περι-οχή, -ῆς, ἡ
(περιέχω), [in LXX for מָצוּד, מָצוֹר, etc. ;]
__1. compass, circumference.
__2. a portion circumscribed, a section: At 8:32.†
(AS)

G4043.def:
περι-πατέω, -ῶ
[in LXX chiefly for הָלַךְ pi., hith. ;]
to walk: absol., Mt 9:5, Mc 5:42, Lc 5:23, Jo 1:36; with pred., γυμνός, Ap 16:15; ἐπάνω Lc 11:44; διά, with genitive, Ap 21:24; ἐν, Mc 11:27 12:38, Jo 7:1 11:54, Ap 2:1, al.; ἐν τ. σκοτίᾳ, figuratively, Jo 8:12 12:35, 1Jo 1:6-7 Jn 2:11; ἐπί, with genitive, Mt 14:26; id. with dative, Mt 14:25, 29; μετά, Jo 6:66, Ap 3:4; παρά, with accusative, Mt 4:18. Metaphorical, of living, passing one's life, conducting oneself (like ἀναστρέφομαι in Xen., Plut., LXX, π.; M, Pv 11:1-31; Deiss., BS, 194) : ἀκριβῶς, Ef 5:15; ἀτάκτως, 2Ts 3:6 3:11; εὐσχημόνως, Ap 13:13, 1Ts 4:12; ἀξίως, with genitive, Ef 4:1, Cl 1:10, 1Ts 2:12; καθώς (ὥς), Ef 4:17 5:8, 15, Fp 3:17, 1Ts 4:1; οὕτως ὥς, 1Co 7:17; before nom. qual., Fp 3:18; with dative, At 21:21, Rm 13:13, 2Co 12:18, Gl 5:16; before ἐν, Rm 6:4, 2Co 4:2 5:7 10:3, Ef 2:2, 10 4:17 5:2, Cl 3:7 4:5, Hb 13:9, 2Jn.4 Jn 6, al.; ἐν Χριστῷ, Cl 2:6; κατά, with accusative, Mc 7:5, Rm 8:4 14:15, 1Co 3:3, 2Co 10:2, 2Jn.6 (cf. ἐν-περιπατέω).
(AS)

G4044.def:
περι-πείρω
to put on a spit, hence, to pierce: metaphorically, ἑαυτὸν . . . ὀδύναις, 1Tm 6:10.†
(AS)

G4045.def:
περι-πίπτω
[in LXX: Rt 2:3, 2Rs 1:6 (קָרָה), Pv 11:5 (נָפַל), Dan LXX 2:9, 2Ma.6:13 2Mac 9:7 2Mac 9:21 2Mac 10:4 * ;]
__1. to fall around.
__2. to fall in with, light upon, come across: with dative, λῃσταῖς, Lc 10:30; πειρασμοῖς, Tg 1:2; before εἰς, At 27:41.†
(AS)

G4046.def:
περι-ποιέω, -ῶ
[in LXX for pi., hi., etc. ;]
to make to remain over, preserve.
Mid.
__(a) to keep or save for oneself: τ. ψυχήν (cf. Xen., Cyr., iv, 4, 10; Arist., Pol., v, 11, 30), Lc 17:33;
__(b) to get or gain for oneself, get possession of (Thuc., Xen., al.) : At 20:28, 1Tm 3:13.†
(AS)

G4047.def:
περι-ποίησις, -εως, ἡ
(περιποιέω), [in LXX: 2Cr 4:13 (12) (מִחְיָה) Ml 3:17 (סְגֻלָּה), Ag 2:10 (9) * ;]
__1. preservation: Hb 10:39 (2 Ch, l.with).
__2. acquisition, obtaining: 1Ts 5:9, 2Ts 2:14 (and so perh. Ef 1:14, see infr.).
__3. a possession: Ef 1:14 (but see supr., and cf. ICC, in l), 1Pe 2:9 (LXX).†
(AS)

G4048.def:
περι-ρήγνυμι
(Rec. -ρρ-, see supr.) [in LXX: 2Ma.4:38 * ;]
to break or tear off all around: frequently of garments, τ. ἰμάτια, At 16:22.†
(AS)

G4049.def:
περι-σπάω, -ῶ
[in LXX chiefly for עָנָה ;]
to draw around, draw off or away. Metaphorical, to distract: pass., Lc 10:40.†
(AS)

G4050.def:
περισσεία, -ας, ἡ
(περισσευω), [in LXX: Ec 12:1-14 (יִתְרוֹן and cogn. forms, Ec 1:3, al.) * ;]
__1. abundance, superfluity: Rm 5:17, 2Co 8:2 10:15, Tg 1:21 (so also Inscr., see LAE, 80).
__2. (a) superiority (Ec, see supr.);
__(b) profit (ib.).†
(AS)

G4051.def:
περίσσευμα, -τος, τό
(περισσεύω) [in LXX: Ec 2:15 * ;]
that which is over and above, superfluity, abundance: opposite to ὑστέρημα (which see), 2Co 8:13-14; pl., Mc 8:8; metaphorically, π. τ. καρδίας, Mt 12:34, Lc 6:45 (cf. Ec, l.with; Plut., al.).†
(AS)

G4052.def:
περισσεύω
(περισσός), [in LXX: 1Rs 2:33 (מַרְבִּית), 1Rs 2:36 Ec 3:19 (יָתַר ni., יוׄתֵר), Tob.4:16, Sir.10:27 11:12 19:24, Sir 30:38 (Sir.33:29), 1Ma.3:30 * ;]
__I. Prop., intrans.,
__1. of things, to be over and above the number (Hes.), hence,
__(a) to be or remain over: Mt 14:20 15:37, Lc 9:17, Jo 6:12-13;
__(b) to abound, be in abundance: Mc 12:44, Lc 12:15 21:4, At 16:5, Rm 3:7 5:15, 2Co 1:5 8:2 9:12, Fp 1:26.
__2. Of persons,
__(a) to abound in, have in abundance: 1Co 14:12 15:58, Fp 4:12, 18; with genitive, Lc 15:17 T;
__(b) to be superior or better, to excel: absol., 1Co 3:9 8:8; with dative ref., 2Co 3:9; before ἐν, Rm 15:13, 1Co 15:58, 2Co 3:9 8:7, Cl 2:7; μᾶλλον, 1Ts 4:1 4:10; μ καὶ μ., Fp 1:9; πλεῖον, Mt 5:20.
__II. In late writers (Lft., Notes, 48 f.), trans.,
__(a) to make to abound: with accusative before εἰς, 2Co 4:15 9:8, Ef 1:8; pass., Mt 13:12 25:29; with genitive of thing(s), Lc 15:17, WH;
__(b) to make to excel: with accusative of person(s), dative of thing(s), 1Ts 3:12 (cf. ὑπερ-περισσεύω).†
SYN.: πλεονάζω (AS)

G4053.def:
περισσός, -ή, -όν
[in LXX for יֶתֶר and cogn. forms ;]
__1. more than sufficient, over and above, abundant: Jo 10:10, 2Co 9:1; with genitive (a popular substitute for πλειών, Bl., § 11, 3.4), Mt 5:37; id. with ellips. genitive, Mt 5:47 (EV, more than others; but see infr.); εκ περισσοῦ, Mc 6:51, Rec., T. (on ὑπὲρ ὲκ π., see: ὑπερεκπερισσοῦ). Compar. neut., -ότερον: Lc 12:4, 48; with genitive, Mc 12:33; adverbially (cf. περισσῶς), more abund­antly, 2Co 10:8, Hb 6:17 7:15; with genitive, π. πάντων, 1Co 15:10; pleonast., μᾶλλον π., Mc 7:36.
__2. out of the common, pre-eminent, superior: Mt 5:47 (Thayer, see word, but see supr.); τὸ π., as subst., Rm 3:1; compar., -ότερος, with genitive, Mt 11:9, Lc 7:26; with subst., Mc 12:40, Lc 20:47, 1Co 12:23-24, 2Co 2:7.†
(AS)

G4054.def:
περισσότερον, -ως, see: περισσῶς.
περισσῶς
adv. (περισσός) [in LXX: Sl 31:23 (יֶתֶר -עַל), Da TH Dn 7:7, 19 8:9 (יַתִּיר, יֶתֶר) 2Ma.8:27 2Mac 12:44 A * ;]
beyond measure, exceedingly, abundantly: Mt 27:23, Mc 10:26 15:14, At 26:11. Compar.
__(a) περισσότερον (see: περισσός);
__(b) περισσοτέρως: 2Co 1:12 2:4 7:15 11:23, Gl 1:14, Fp 1:14, 1Ts 2:17, Hb 2:1 13:19; π. μᾶλλον, 2Co 7:13; opposite to ἧττον, 2Co 12:15.†
(AS)

G4055.def: more superabundant rabundant, excess, far fetched, superfluous (in number, degree or character)

G4056.def: to a greater degree; especially, frequently, extremely more, more abundantly, more earnestly, more vehemently, 2Cor. 7:13; exceedingly, extremely Gal. 1:14

G4057.def:
περισσῶς
adv. (περισσός) [in LXX: Sl 31:23 (יֶתֶר -עַל), Da TH Dn 7:7, 19 8:9 (יַתִּיר, יֶתֶר) 2Ma.8:27 2Mac 12:44 A * ;]
beyond measure, exceedingly, abundantly: Mt 27:23, Mc 10:26 15:14, At 26:11. Compar.
__(a) περισσότερον (see: περισσός);
__(b) περισσοτέρως: 2Co 1:12 2:4 7:15 11:23, Gl 1:14, Fp 1:14, 1Ts 2:17, Hb 2:1 13:19; π. μᾶλλον, 2Co 7:13; opposite to ἧττον, 2Co 12:15.†
(AS)

G4058.def:
περιστερά, -ᾶς, ἡ
[in LXX chiefly for יוֹנָה ;]
a dove: Mt 3:16 10:16 21:12, Mc 1:10 11:15, Lc 2:24 3:22, Jo 1:32 2:14, 16†
(AS)

G4059.def:
περι-τέμνω
[in LXX chiefly for מוּל ;] (Ion., Epic. and late writers),
to cut around (Hdt.), hence, to circumcise (π. τὰ αἰδοῖα, Hdt.) : Lc 1:59 2:21, Jo 7:22, At 7:8 15:5 16:3 21:21. Pass. and mid., to be circumcised, receive circumcision: At 15:1, 1Co 7:18, Gl 2:3 5:2-3 6:12-13 Metaphorical (cf. Dt 10:16, Jr 4:4, al.), Cl 2:11 (see Deiss., BS, 151 f.; MM, xix).†
(AS)

G4060.def:
περι-τίθημι
[in LXX for נָתַן, שׂוּם, etc. ;]
to place or put around: with accusative and dative, Mt 21:33 27:48, Mc 12:1 15:36, Jo 19:29; of garments, etc., to put on: Mt 27:28 Mc 15:17 (Sir.6:31). Metaphorical, like περιβάλλω, to bestow, confer (Thuc., al., Et 1:20): 1Co 12:23.†
(AS)

G4061.def:
περι-τομή, -ῆς, ἡ
(περιτέμνω), [in LXX: Gn 17:13, Êx 4:25-26 (מוּל ni., מוּלָה), Jr 11:16 * ;]
circumcision;
__(a) of the rite itself : Jo 7:22-23 At 7:8, Rm 4:11, Gl 5:11, Fp 3:5;
__(b) of the state of circumcision: Rm 2:25-28 3:1, 1Co 7:19, Gl 5:6 6:15, Cl 3:11; ἐν π. ὤν, Rm 4:10;
__(with) by meton., π. = οἱ περιτμηθέντες, the circumcised: Rm 3:30 4:9, 12 15:8, Gl 2:7-9, Ef 2:11; οἱ ἐκ τῆς π., of Jews, Rm 4:12; of Jewish Christians, At 11:2, Gl 2:12, Tt 1:10; οἱ ἐκ π. πιστοί, At 10:45; οἱ ὄντες ἐκ π., Cl 4:11 Metaphorical, Rm 2:29, Cl 2:11, Fp 3:3.†
(AS)

G4062.def:
περι-τρέπω
[in LXX: Wis.5:23 * ;]
to turn about, turn: with accusative and, dative, At 26:24 (cf. FlJ, Ant., ix, 4, 4).†
(AS)

G4063.def:
περι-τρέχω
[in LXX: Am 8:12, Jr 5:1 (שׁוּט pi.) * ;]
to run about: with accusative loc., Mc 6:55.†
(AS)

G4064.def:
περι-φέρω
[in LXX: Ec 7:8 (7) (הָלַל po.), al. ;]
to carry about: Mc 6:55, 2Co 4:10. Pass., metaphorically: Ef 4:14.†
(AS)

G4065.def:
περι-φρονέω, -ῶ
[in LXX: 4Ma.6:9 4Mac 14:1 * ;]
__1. to examine on all sides, consider carefully (Aristoph.).
__2. = ὑπερφρονέω, to have thouphts beyond, to despise (Thuc., Plut., al.; 4Mac, ll. with) : Tt 2:15.†
(AS)

G4066.def:
περί-χωρος, -ον
[in LXX: chiefly (ἡ π.) for כִּכָּר ;]
round about, neighbouring (Dem., Plut., al.). In LXX and NT, as subst., ἡ π. (sc. γῆ), the region round about: Mt 14:35, Mc 1:28, Lc 4:14, 37 7:17 8:37, At 14:6; ἡ π. τοῦ Ἰορδάνου, Lc 3:3; by meton. for the people of the same region, Mt 3:5.†
(AS)

G4067.def:
περί-ψημα, -τος, τό
(περιψράω, to wipe off all round), [in LXX: Tob.5:18 * ;]
that which is wiped off, offscouring: metaphorically (assoc. with περικάθαρμα, which see), 1Co 4:13 (and so prob., To, l.with, as EV; but see Thayer, see word, for the meaning expiation, ransom, in To; and cf. LS, see word κάθαρμα; Lft., Notes, 200 f., and on Ign., Eph., 8).†
(AS)

G4068.def:
περπερεύοραι
(περπερος, vainglorious)
to boast or vaunt oneself: 1Co 13:4 (elsewhere. only in Antonin.; see Abbott, Essays, 87).†
(AS)

G4069.def:
1. Persian , (Aeschulus Tragicus), etc.
2. as Substantive, (.] (entry γῆ); Persis, Persia , now Farsistan , (Herdotus Historicus)
3. (entry γυνή); a Persian woman , (Xenophon Historicus)
4. (entry χλαῖνα); a Persian cloak , (Aristophanes Comicus)
(ML)

G4070.def:
πέρυσι
adv. (πέρας),
last year, a year ago: ἀπὸ π. (as in π. see Deiss., BS, 221; LAE, 70), 2Co 8:10 9:2.†
(AS)

G4071.def:
πετεινός, -ή, -όν
(πέτομαι), [in LXX chiefly for עוֹף ;]
in trag., Ion. and late writers, winged, flying; as subst., τὸ π., a winged fowl, a bird: pl., Mt 6:26 8:20 13:4, 32, Mc 4:4, 32, Lc 8:5 9:58 12:24 13:19, At 10:12 11:6, Rm 1:23, Tg 3:7.†
(AS)

G4072.def:
πέτομαι
[in LXX chiefly for עוּף ;]
to fly: Ap 4:7 8:13 12:14 14:6 19:17 (Rec. πετάομαι, which see).†
πετάομαι,
[in LXX: Dt 4:17 * ;]
false form of ποτάομαι, poët., frequentat. of πέτομαι (Aristoph., al.), Rec. for πέτομαι (which see, cf. Veitch, see word)
(AS)

G4073.def:
πέτρα, -ας, ἡ
[in LXX chiefly for סֶלַע, צוּר ;]
a rock, i.e. a mass of live rock as distinct from πέτρος, a detached stone or boulder : Mt 7:24-25 27:51, 60 Mc 15:46, Lc 6:48 8:6, 13; of a hollow rock, a cave, Ap 6:15-16 (of. Is 2:10, al.). Metaphorical, Mt 16:18 (on the meaning, see Hort, Eccl., 16 ff., but cf. also ICC, in l), 1Co 10:4; = πέτρος, Rm 9:33, 1Pe 2:8" (LXX) .†
(AS)

G4074G.def:
Πέτρος, -ου, ὁ (i.e. a stone, see: πέτρα, Κηφᾶς),
Simon Peter, the Apostle: Mt 4:18 10:2, Mc 3:16, Lc 5:8, Jo 1:41, 43, al.
(AS)

G4075.def:
πετρώδης, -ες
(πέτρα, εἶδος),
rock-like, rocky, stony: τὸ, τὰ π., of shallow soil with underlying rock, Mt 13:5, 20, Mc 4:5, 16.†
(AS)

G4076.def:
πήγανον, -ου, τό
περισσότερον, -ως, see: περισσῶς
περισσῶς
adv. (περισσός) [in LXX: Sl 31:23 (יֶתֶר -עַל), Da TH Dn 7:7, 19 8:9 (יַתִּיר, יֶתֶר) 2Ma.8:27 2Mac 12:44 A * ;]
beyond measure, exceedingly, abundantly: Mt 27:23, Mc 10:26 15:14, At 26:11. Compar.
__(a) περισσότερον (see: περισσός);
__(b) περισσοτέρως: 2Co 1:12 2:4 7:15 11:23, Gl 1:14, Fp 1:14, 1Ts 2:17, Hb 2:1 13:19; π. μᾶλλον, 2Co 7:13; opposite to ἧττον, 2Co 12:15.†
(AS)

G4077.def:
πηγή, -ῆς, ἡ
[in LXX chiefly for עַיִן, also for מָקוֹר, etc. ;]
a spring, fountain : Tg 3:11, 2Pe 2:17; τ. δάτων, Ap 8:10 14:7 16:4; of a well fed by a spring, Jo 4:6; π. τοῦ αἵματος, of a flow of blood, Mc 5:29; metaphorically, Jo 4:14, Ap 7:17 21:6.†
(AS)

G4078.def:
πήγνυμι
[in LXX chiefly for נָטָה, also for תָּקַע, etc. ;]
to make fast, to fix; of tents, to pitch: Hb 8:2 (cf. προσ-πήγνυμι).†
(AS)

G4079.def:
πηδάλιον, -συ, τό
(πηδός, the blade of an oar),
a rudder: Tg 3:4; pl., At 27:40.†
(AS)

G4080.def:
πηλίκος, -η, -ον
[in LXX: Zc 2:2 (6) (כָּמַהּ), 4Ma.15:22 * ;]
interrog., how large, how great ? (prop., of magnitude, as πόσος of quantity): in exclamations, = ἡλίκος (see Bl., § 51, 4), Gl 6:11; of personal greatness, Hb 7:4.†
(AS)

G4081.def:
πηλός, οῦ, ἁ
[in LXX chiefly for חֹמֶר, טִיט ]
__1. clay, as used by a potter: Rm 9:21 (cf. Is 29:16, al.).
__2. - βόρβορος, wet clay, mud: Jo 9:6, 11 9:14-15 †
(AS)

G4082.def:
πἡρα, -ας, ἡ
[in LXX: Jdth.10:5 13:10, 15 * ;]
a leathern pouch for victuals, etc., a wallet (Deiss. thinks an alms-bag, see LAE, 108 ff.): Mt 10:10, Mc 6:8, Lc 9:3 10:4 22:35-36.†
(AS)

G4083.def:
πῆχυς, -εως genitive pl., -ῶν (for Att.. -εων, see WH, App., 157; Thackeray, Gr., 151; Deiss., BS, 153),
[in LXX chiefly and frequently for אַמָּה ;]
__1. the forearm (Hom.).
__2. As a measure of length, a cubit: Mt 6:27, Lc 12:25, Jo 21:8, Ap 21:17.†
(AS)

G4084.def:
πιάζω
(cf. MGr. πιάνω; see Kennedy, Sources, 155), Doric and late Att.. for πιέζω in its later senses [in LXX: Ct 2:15 (אָחַז), Sir.23:21 * ;]
__1. to lay hold of: At 3:7 (Theocr.).
__2. to take, capture, apprehend: Jo 7:30, 32 7:44 8:20 10:39 11:57 21:3, 10 At 12:4, 2Co 11:32, Ap 19:20 (see MM, xx).†
(AS)

G4085.def:
πιέζω
[in LXX : Mq 6:15 (דָּרַךְ)* ;]
__1. to press, press down or to­gether: Lc 6:38 (cl).
__2. Later, to seize (see: πιάζω).†
(AS)

G4086.def:
πιθανολογία, -ας, ἡ
(πιθανός, persuasive, plausible),
in cl. (Plat),
the use of probable arguments, as opposite to demonstration (ἀπόδειξις); hence, persuasive speech: Cl 2:4 (see ICC, in l).†
(AS)

G4087.def:
πικραίνω
(πικρός), [in LXX for מָרַד, קָצַף, etc. ;]
to make bitter: Ap 10:9; pass., Ap 8:11 10:10; metaphorically, to embitter (LXX) : pass., before πρός, Cl 3:19.†
(AS)

G4088.def:
πικρία, -ας, ἡ
(πικρός), [in LXX chiefly for מַר and cognate forms ;]
bitterness;
__(a) of taste (Arist., Jr 15:17, al.);
__(b) metaphorically, of temper, character, etc.: Rm 3:14 (LXX), Ef 4:31; ῥίζα πικρίας, Hb 12:15; χολὴ π., a malignant disposition, At 8:23.†
(AS)

G4089.def:
πικρός, -ά, -όν
(poët. in cl.), [in LXX chiefly for מַר ;]
__1. sharp, pointed.
__2. sharp to the senses; of taste, bitter: opposite to γλυκύ, Tg 3:11; metaphorically, harsh, bitter: Tg 3:14
(AS)

G4090.def:
πικρῶς
adv. (πικρός), [in LXX for מַר, מָרַר pi. ;]
bitterly: metaphorically, (cf. πικρὸν δάκρυον, Hom.), ἔκλαυσε π., Mt 26:75, Lc 22:62 (see MM, xviii, see word παρακολουθέω).†
(AS)

G4091.def:
Πειλᾶτος (Rec. Πιλάτος, Tr., -ᾶτος, see WH, App., 155), -ου, ὁ,
Pontius Pilate: Mt 27:2, Mc 15:1, Lc 3:1, Jo 18:29, At 3:13, 1Tm 6:13, al
(AS)

G4092.def:
πίμπρημι
(in cl. prose, rare in the simple form), [in LXX: Nm 5:21-22, 27 (צָבֶה) * ;]
__1. to blow, burn.
__2. Later, to cause to swell; mid., of parts of the body, to become swollen (LXX) : At 28:6 (cf. ἐμπίπρημι).†
(AS)

G4093.def:
πινακίδιον, -ου, τό
(dimin. of πινακίς, which see), [in Sm.: Eze.9:2 * ;]
a writing tablet: Lc 1:63.†
(AS)

G4094.def:
πίναξ, -ακος, ὁ
[in LXX: 4Ma.17:7 R * ;]
prop., a board, plank; hence, of various at wooden articles;
__(a) a tablet;
__(b) a disc, a dish: Mt 14:8, 11, Mc 6:25, 28 Lc 11:39.†
(AS)

G4095.def:
πίνω
[in LXX chiefly for שָׁתָה ;]
to drink: absol., Lc 2:19, Jo 4:7, al.; with accusative of thing(s), Mt 6:26, 31 Mc 14:25, al.; of habitual use, Lc 1:15, Rm 14:21, al.; by meton., τὸ ποτήριον, 1Co 10:21, al.; of the earth absorbing rain (Hdt., al.), Hb 6:7; spiritually, of the blood of Christ, Jo 6:53-54, 56; before ἐκ (of the vessel), Mt 26:27, al.; id. (of the drink; Bl., § 36, 1), Mt 26:29, Jo 4:13-14 Ap 14:10, al.; ἀπό, Lc 22:18 (cf. ἀπο-, συν-πίνω; on the form πίεσαι, Lc 17:8, see Bl., § 21, 8, and on the contr. aor. πεῖν, M, Pr., 44 f., Thackeray, Gr., 63 f.)
(AS)

G4096.def:
πιότης, -ητος, ἡ
(πίων, fat), [in LXX chiefly for דֶּשֶׁן ;]
fatness: Rm 11:17.†
(AS)

G4097.def:
πιπράσκω
[in LXX chiefly for מָכַר ni. ;]
to sell: with accusative of thing(s), Mt 13:46 (on this pf., see Bl., § 59, 5), At 2:45 4:34 5:4; with genitive (of price), Mt 26:9, Mc 14:5, Jo 12:5; with accusative of person(s) (of slavery), Mt 18:25; hence metaphorically, Rm 7:14 (cf. 4Ki.17:17, 1Ma.1:15, al.).†
(AS)

G4098.def:
πίπτω
[in LXX chiefly for נָפַל ;]
to fall;
__1. of descent, to fall, fall down or from: before ἐπί, with accusative loc., Mt 10:29, al.; εἰς, Mt 15:14, al.; ἐς μέσῳ, with genitive, Lc 8:7; παρὰ τ. ὁδόν, Mt 13:4, Mc 4:4, Lc 8:5; before ἀπό, Mt 15:27, al.; ἐκ, Mc 13:25, Lc 10:18, Ap 8:10 9:1. Metaphorical: ὁ ἥλιος, before ἐπί, Ap 7:16; ἀχλὺς κ. σκότος, At 13:11; ὁ κλῆρος, At 1:26; ὑπὸ κρίσιν, Tg 5:12.
__2. Of prostration,
__(a) of persons, to fall prostrate, prostrate oneself: χαμαί Jo 18:6; before ἐπί, with accusative, Mt 17:6, At 9:4; id. with genitive, Mc 9:20; πρὸς τ. πόδας, At 5:10, Ap 1:17; πεσὼν ἐξέψυξε, At 5:5; of supplication, homage or worship: πρὸς (παρὰ, ἐπὶ) τ. πὸδας, Mc 5:22, Lc 8:41, At 10:25, al.; π. καὶ προσκυνεῖν, Ap 5:14 19:4; ptcp. with προσκυνεῖν, Mt 2:11, al.; ἐνώπιον, Ap 4:10 5:8; ἐπὶ πρόσωπον, Mt 26:39, al.;
__(b) of things, to fall, fall down: Mt 21:44, Lc 23:30; of falling to ruin and destruction, Mt 7:25, At 15:16, Hb 11:30; ἔπεσε (timeless aorist; M, Pr.,134), Ap 18:2. Metaphorical: Rm 11:11; πόθεν πέπτωκας, Ap 2:5; opposite to ἑστόναι, 1Co 10:12; to στήκειν, Rm 14:4; of virtues, 1Co 13:8; of precepts, Lc 16:17.
(cf. ἀνα-, ἀντι-, ἀπο-, ἐκ-, ἐπι-, κατα-, παρα-, περι-, προσ-, συν-πίπτω.)
συν-πίπτω (Rec. συμπ-),
[in LXX for נָפַל, etc. ;]
to fall together, fall in, etc.: of a house (cf. MM, xxiv), Lc 6:49.†
(AS)

G4099.def:
Πισιδία, -ας, ι
Pisidia, a region of Asia Minor: At 14:24
(AS)
